name: Alt Almanac
summary: See the level, gold, location and rested bonus of every character on your account in a single window.

bullets: Level, gold and zone per character

description: **Alt Almanac keeps one page for every character you play, so you know who is ready to level, who holds the gold and where everyone was left.**
## Features
- One row per character: name in class colour, level, gold, zone and when you last played it.
- Rested bonus for each character. For the ones you are not playing it keeps growing, faster for those who logged out in an inn or a city.
- Total gold of all your characters.
- Sorted by level, then by name, in a window you can drag anywhere.
## How to use
Log in once with each character so it is added. Type `/aa` (or `/altalmanac`) to open or close the list; Escape closes it too.
## In detail
### The alt overview window

Each row shows the character name in its class colour, the level, the gold it carries, the zone and subzone where you left it, the rested bonus and when you last played it ("now", "12m", "3h", "2d"). Characters from another realm get the realm name in grey. The highest level comes first, equal levels are sorted by name. The window has room for 15 rows; with more characters the last row says how many are left out. The total gold of every character in the list is shown at the bottom.
### Rested XP

The rested bonus is shown as a percent of a level, up to the game's cap of 150%. For characters you are not playing, the addon estimates how far it has grown since you logged out: 5% every 8 hours in an inn or a city, a quarter of that anywhere else. Resting characters are shown in blue. At maximum level the column shows a dash.
### When a character is updated

The character you are playing is saved at login and logout, and whenever your gold, level, zone, rested bonus or resting state changes. The open window refreshes at the same moments. Other characters keep the values from their last session.
### Removing a character
`/aa forget Name-Realm` removes a deleted or transferred character from the list. Upper and lower case do not matter. The character you are playing cannot be removed.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail only. No combat data and no chat parsing.
- Gold in the warband bank or a guild bank is not counted.
- The addon is in English.
- The list is saved for your whole account and every character stays in it until you remove it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
